title: Conversational AI for Perceived Cognitive Decline Screening in Older Adults
abstract: arXiv:2610.27344v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Early detection of cognitive decline in older adults remains challenging due to the resource demands of standard neuropsychological assessments. Chatbot-based Intelligent Cognitive Assistants (ICAs) provide a scalable alternative by eliciting open-ended responses rich in linguistic, semantic, and autobiographical cues. This study evaluates whether ICA question-answer (Q/A) interviews with older adults can screen for participant-reported perceived cognitive decline and related cognitive, functional, and personality outcomes. We compare traditional machine learning, frozen transformer embeddings, fine-tuned transformers, and large language model (LLM) reasoning strategies across Global Q/A, Single Q/A confidence averaging, and Aggregated Q/A pipelines. Among text-based methods, Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite (1-example-per-class, Aggregated Q/A) achieved the highest held-out test performance (0.742 accuracy, 0.739 balanced accuracy, 0.728 macro-F1)

translated_title: 面向老年人主观认知衰退筛查的对话式人工智能
translated_abstract: 由于标准神经心理学评估对资源的高需求，老年人认知衰退的早期检测仍然具有挑战性。基于聊天机器人的智能认知助手（ICAs）通过引导生成富含语言、语义和自传体线索的开放式回答，提供了一种可扩展的替代方案。本研究评估了智能认知助手与老年人进行问答（Q/A）访谈能否筛查参与者自报的主观认知衰退及相关认知、功能和人格结果。我们在全局问答、单问答置信度平均和聚合问答三种流程下，比较了传统机器学习、冻结transformer嵌入、微调transformer以及大语言模型（LLM）推理策略。在基于文本的方法中，Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite（每类仅一个示例、聚合问答流程）取得了最高的留出测试集性能（准确率0.742、平衡准确率0.739、宏F1值0.728）。
tldr: 该研究证明了基于聊天机器人的智能认知助手问答访谈可用于筛查老年人主观认知衰退，其中采用每类单示例的Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite在聚合问答流程下取得了最佳筛查性能。
en_tdlr: This study demonstrates that chatbot-based Intelligent Cognitive Assistant Q/A interviews can effectively screen for perceived cognitive decline in older adults, with Gemini 3.1 Flash Lite using a one-example-per-class aggregated Q/A pipeline achieving the best performance.
